name: design-intelligence
description: Product and UX design judgment grounded in evidence: framing, information architecture, interaction, usability/accessibility review, visual communication, and design-system governance; excludes Figma, CSS, and framework recipes.

interface.shortDescription: Product and UX decisions for accessible, usable flows.
interface.longDescription: Product and UX design decisions use technology-agnostic, source-backed judgment across framing, interface architecture, interaction design, usability/accessibility review, visual communication, and design-system governance. The plugin recognizes forms, data views, search/browse, onboarding, permissions, empty/error states, settings, notifications, and transactions while deliberately avoiding Figma automation, CSS recipes, framework recipes, and design-tool workflows.
capabilities: Forms, data views, search, empty state, and error recovery reasoning
Usability heuristic and cognitive walkthrough review
defaultPrompt: Use Design Intelligence to frame this product decision before designing screens.
Use Design Intelligence to audit this flow for usability, accessibility, hierarchy, interaction, and product risks.
Use Design Intelligence to improve the interface architecture and information hierarchy without focusing on Figma or CSS.
Use Design Intelligence to review this UI surface as task, content, state, feedback, recovery, accessibility, and trust design.
